column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_limitlist.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Module entry stub at offset 0: returns 0 and does nothing else, the library-module e_entry shape (jr ra; li v0, 0) described in modules.md (rel_limitlist registers no scene). No side effects. No direct caller (started by the kernel through system_module_load).

Start function of the forbidden/limited list screen (liblimitlist_rel export): clears the 0x60-byte screen block 0xa6c0, stores mode & 3 in bits 0-1 of the halfword 0xa6c4, and uses heap as the work heap 0xa6ec, or when heap is 0 creates its own: sceKernelCreateFpl (name 0xa09c, partition 2, 0x500000 bytes) into 0xa714, sceKernelAllocateFpl into 0xa718 and system_heap_create on it. Then sceKernelChangeCurrentThreadAttr(0, 0x4000), ui_limitlist_init_resources, loads BGM track 0x2c8 (audio_release_all_banks first) unless sound 2 is already playing (audio_get_sound_status bit 0), enables font shadow and colour codes, and sets font flag 1 / trim-wrap-spaces for Japanese (language 0) versus other languages. No return value. Side effects: screen block, FPL and heap, audio banks, font state. No direct caller; exported, called from rel_story (world_state_start_limit_list), rel_title (ui_title_update_limit_list) and rel_labo (0x00000034).

Per-frame update of the limit-list screen, a switch on the state halfword 0xa6c0: 0 loading (ui_limitlist_update_loading; when done builds the lists, state 1, fade in from black over 0x10 frames, hides the loading overlay, audio_play_track_with_fade(2)); 1 waits for the fade, then 2; 2 browsing (ui_limitlist_update_browse); 3 and 5 dialogs (ui_limitlist_update_dialog); 4 card viewer (ui_limitlist_update_card_viewer); 6 waits for the exit fade, then 7; 7 teardown (ui_limitlist_shutdown_step). Returns 0 while running, and when the teardown finishes 1, or 2 when bit 4 of byte 0xa6c5 is set (the player left through the deck-warning dialog with result 2; meaning for the caller is a hypothesis, confidence medium). Side effects: those of the state handlers. No direct caller; exported, called from rel_story (world_state_update_limit_list), rel_title (ui_title_update_limit_list) and rel_labo (0x00000034).

Teardown, step in bits 6-9 of 0xa6c4: step 0 frees the three card lists (ui_limitlist_free_lists) and the loaded resources (ui_limitlist_free_resources), closes the card view (ui_card_view_close), asks the card image reader 0xa6f0 to stop (card_db_cip_request_stop) when it exists, and advances; step 1 advances when card_db_cip_is_idle(0xa6f0); step 2 frees and deletes the module's own FPL 0xa714 when it is positive, clears the step and returns 1. Returns 0 in the other steps (and for an unknown step). Side effects: step bits, heap frees, card view, FPL. Callers: 1 (deck_limit_list_update, state 7).

Draw function of the limit-list screen: clears GE layer 0 to black (colour 0xff000000, stencil 0, depth 0, clear flags 0x17). In states other than 0 and 7: when the card viewer is open (bit 3 of byte 0xa6c5) draws only ui_card_viewer_draw; otherwise on layer 4 sets texture/blend state and draws the background (ui_limitlist_draw_background), the card detail view of block 0xa6f4 (ui_draw_card_detail_view_temp), the tabs, the title bar and the cards, then either the dialog (states 3 and 5, ui_limitlist_draw_dialog) or the cursor frame (shop_draw_cursor_frame with the rectangle 0xa6d2-0xa6d8, image resource 0x8006 and the frame counter); finally the fade on layer 5 (system_draw_fade). No return value. Side effects: GE display lists of layers 0, 4 and 5. No direct caller; exported, called from rel_story (world_state_update_limit_list) and rel_title (ui_title_draw_limit_list).

When the EHF layout resource 0x8021 is loaded (ui_limitlist_get_resource) plays it with a cleared 0x60-byte parameter block whose word 0 is the frame counter (system_get_frame_timing), between ui_ehf_begin_draw and ui_ehf_end_draw, then restores texture function and blend state. Returns the advanced display list (list unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_limit_list_draw).

Draws the three tabs (forbidden, limited, semi-limited) when the EHF resource 0x1010 is loaded: plays the layout, then with scissor (0, 0x1a, 480, 12) and font scale 12 x 12 draws each tab label (dictionary resource 0x1020, word from the table 0xa0c4[i]) with ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit at x = per-language table 0xa0a0[language * 3 + i] - 0x59, y 0x1b for the selected tab (bits 2-5 of 0xa6c4, white) or 0x1d (grey 0xffbfbfbf), width 0x48; then each tab's entry count 0xa6da[i] in black at scale 11 x 12 with shop_draw_number_plain (3 digits); finally the scrollbar (shop_draw_scrollbar at (0x1d5, 0x32), height 0xc0, top 0xa6c6[tab], visible 7 rows or 0x42 cells in grid view, count 0xa6da[tab], style 2, image resource 0x8007). Returns the advanced list (unchanged without the layout). Side effects: GE commands, font state. Callers: 1 (deck_limit_list_draw).

column2: void ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper, same code as BOOT ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit: tail-calls system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1) (the decompiler shows an empty body because of the tail jump). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_draw_tabs).

When the GIM resource 0x1002 is loaded draws the title bar: two 12 x 23 end pieces at x 0x94 and 0x1d3 and a 0x133-wide middle strip at x 0xa0 (texture rows 0x14), then the current limit-list name (deck_get_limit_list_name) in white at scale 14 x 14 at pixel (0x9c, 4) with ui_limitlist_draw_text_to_edge. Returns the advanced list (unchanged without the resource). Side effects: GE commands, font state. Callers: 1 (deck_limit_list_draw).

column2: void ui_limitlist_draw_text_to_edge(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Same code as BOOT ui_list_window_draw_text: draws text from pixel x to the right screen edge, system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text) (the decompiler only shows the argument computation). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_draw_title_bar).

Draws the cards of the current tab: the thumbnail grid (ui_limitlist_draw_card_grid) when the view flag bit 2 of byte 0xa6c5 is set, otherwise the detailed rows (ui_limitlist_draw_card_rows). Returns the advanced list from the called drawer (passed through in v0; confidence medium). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_limit_list_draw).

Row view: for the current tab t (bits 2-5 of 0xa6c4) draws up to 7 rows starting at the scroll top 0xa6c6[t] (fewer at the end of the list, count 0xa6da[t]): each 6-byte entry of the list 0xa6e0[t] goes to ui_limitlist_draw_card_row at x 0x97, y 0x29 + 0x1e * row. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_draw_cards).

Grid view: from the scroll top 0xa6c6[t] of the current tab draws up to 6 rows of 11 thumbnails with shop_draw_card_thumb (shadow on, colour white, images resources 0x8001 and 0x8002, variant table 0x8032) at x 0x9c + 0x1c * column, y 0x2e + 0x22 * row, stopping at the list count 0xa6da[t]. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_draw_cards).

column2: void * ui_limitlist_draw_card_row(void *list, short x, short y, short *entry)
column3: Draws one detailed row for the 6-byte entry (u16 card id at +0, u16 thumbnail index at +2): the name plate for the card's frame (ui_draw_card_frame_plate, width 0x13e, at x + 0x17), the thumbnail (shop_draw_card_thumb), the name (card_db_get_name, black, scale 12, width 0x108, at x + 0x1d, y + 2; non-Japanese text with font flag 0x4000 and no trim); for spells and traps (frame 7 or 8) the attribute and spell/trap icons, for monsters attribute, race, level badge and ATK/DEF (shop_draw_stat_value, value 0xffff shown as '?'); then three count badges (shop_draw_results_row_badges) built from the template 0xa0cc: for non-fusion cards copies in member 0's main deck (list 1) and side deck (list 2) plus save card-list entries of state 1 and 2 (whose badge colour turns 0xff0080ff), and the remaining owned copies (save_get_card_count minus both); for fusion cards the first badge is hidden, the second counts the extra deck (list 3) plus state-3 card-list entries, the third the rest. Returns the advanced list (from the badge drawer; confidence medium). Side effects: GE commands, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_draw_card_rows).

column2: void ui_window_draw_text_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper, same code as BOOT ui_window_draw_text_px: tail-calls system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text) (empty body in the decompiler because of the tail jump). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_draw_card_row).

Opens the screen's menu: clears the 0x530-byte dialog block 0xa720 and fills the list-window record at 0xab30 (2 items at +0xcc, title = dictionary word 3 of resource 0x1020 at +0xa0, item text scale 12, black, item draw callback ui_limitlist_draw_menu_item at +0xfc, work heap 0xa6ec, size fields 0x136 x 0x10), calls ui_open_list_window, centres the window (x = (480 - width) / 2, y = (272 - height) / 2 + 0x14), sets the dialog mode 0xa720 = 0 and the screen state 0xa6c0 = 3. No return value. Side effects: 0xa720-0xac4f, screen state, window opened. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_update_browse, triangle button).

Opens the warning shown when leaving with a deck that breaks the list: formats into 0xa728 (system_swprintf) the dictionary word 9 (forbidden or other), 10 (limit 1) or 11 (limit 2) chosen by deck_get_current_card_limit(card_id), with the card name (card_db_get_name) as argument; fills the list-window record 0xab30 as a message with 3 buttons (+0xd4 = 3), opens and centres it, sets the dialog mode 0xa720 = 3 and the screen state 5. No return value. Side effects: dialog block 0xa720-0xac4f, screen state, window opened. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_update_browse).

Opens the choice of imported limit lists after a save import: re-initialises the window record 0xab30 (0x120 bytes) with title dictionary word 1, item count = imported list count 0xab28 + 1 (+0xcc), 8 visible rows (+0xce), item draw callback ui_limitlist_draw_import_item, opens it (ui_open_list_window), widens it to the minimum width +0x80 if needed and centres it; sets dialog mode 0xa720 = 1. No return value. Side effects: dialog block, window opened. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_update_dialog).

Dialog update for states 3 and 5. Without a running import (bit 0 of 0xa724 clear) steps the list window 0xab30 (ui_update_list_window) and, on a result, resets it and acts by dialog mode 0xa720: mode 3 (deck warning) result 2 fades out, sets bit 4 of byte 0xa6c5 and state 6, otherwise back to state 2; mode 1 (imported lists) result -2 (cancel) returns to state 2, otherwise ui_limitlist_apply_list(result) then state 2; mode 0 (menu) result 1 restores the built-in list (deck_reset_limits, ui_limitlist_build_lists), result 0 starts a save import (save_import_begin with the work heap, sets the import flag, step 0xa722 = 0), anything else returns to state 2; every return to state 2 frees the imported lists. With the import running, step 0xa722: 0 save_import_update_scan(2, &0xab28) (kind 2 = limit lists), 1 allocates count x 0x108 bytes at 0xab2c (or goes to 3 for none), 2 save_import_update_load(0xab2c, &0xab28), 3 clears the flag and opens ui_limitlist_open_import_list. No return value. Side effects: screen state, dialog block, imported lists, game limit table. Callers: 1 (deck_limit_list_update).

Draws the open dialog: the list window 0xab30 (ui_draw_list_window) or, while a save import runs (bit 0 of 0xa724), the import message box (save_import_update_message(list)). Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands, message box state. Callers: 1 (deck_limit_list_draw).

column2: void ui_limitlist_draw_menu_item(void *list, uint index, int x, int y)
column3: List-window item callback of the menu: at scale 12 in black draws the dictionary word (resource 0x1020) numbered by the u16 table 0xa0f0[index] at (x, y + 2) with ui_list_window_draw_text, inside its own external font list. No return value. Side effects: font drawing. No direct caller (item callback stored at +0xfc of the window record by ui_limitlist_open_menu).

column2: void ui_list_window_draw_text(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Same code as BOOT ui_list_window_draw_text: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text) (only the argument computation is visible). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_draw_menu_item).

column2: void ui_limitlist_draw_import_item(void *list, uint index, int x, int y)
column3: List-window item callback of the imported-list choice: at scale 12 in black draws, with ui_limitlist_draw_text_fit and width 0x136 at (x, y + 2), system message 5 for item 0 (the built-in list) or the UTF-16 name at +0 of the imported record index - 1 (0x108-byte records at *0xab2c). No return value. Side effects: font drawing. No direct caller (item callback set by ui_limitlist_open_import_list).

column2: void ui_limitlist_draw_text_fit(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Same code as BOOT ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit: tail-calls system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_draw_import_item).

Applies the chosen list: index 0 restores the built-in list (deck_reset_limits); otherwise sets every card id 0xe88-0x1f39 to unlimited (deck_set_limit(id, 3)), applies the record's pairs (count u16 at record +0x100, pointer to count x {u16 card id, u16 status} at +0x104 of the 0x108-byte record index - 1 at *0xab2c) with deck_set_limit and stores the record's name (+0) with deck_set_limit_list_name; then rebuilds the screen lists (ui_limitlist_build_lists). Returns 1. Side effects: the limit status of every card and the list name in game state, screen lists. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_update_dialog).

When the imported-record array *0xab2c exists frees each record's pair array (word +0x104 when non-zero) and then the array itself from the work heap 0xa6ec, and clears 0xab2c. No return value. Side effects: heap frees, 0xab2c. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_update_dialog).

Rebuilds the three tab lists: frees the old ones, allocates three temporary 0x1b5a-byte id arrays and zeroes the counts 0xa6da[0..2]; every card id 0xe88-0x1f39 that is valid (card_db_is_valid) and whose current limit (deck_get_current_card_limit) is 0, 1 or 2 goes into list[limit]; each list is sorted with system_qsort and ui_limitlist_compare_cards; then for each list allocates count x 6 bytes at 0xa6e0[i] holding {u16 card id, u16 thumbnail index = shop_find_in_sorted_table(id, resource 0x8031), u8 flags = 1}; frees the temporaries, zeroes the scroll tops 0xa6c6[] and cursors 0xa6cc[], sets the tab animation, the cursor rectangle and the detail card. No return value. Side effects: heap allocations, list pointers and counts, cursor state. Callers: 3 (deck_limit_list_update, ui_limitlist_update_dialog, ui_limitlist_apply_list).

Frees the three tab list arrays 0xa6e0[0..2] from the work heap 0xa6ec and clears the pointers. No return value. Side effects: heap frees, 0xa6e0. Callers: 2 (ui_limitlist_build_lists, ui_limitlist_shutdown_step).

Input handler of the browse state 2 (pad state from system_pad_get_state, +4 pressed): the button system_get_confirm_button(1) (0x2000) leaves: ui_limitlist_find_deck_violation returns 0 -> fade out, audio_stop_sounds_bgm_arg(600), state 6, sound 0x7a06, otherwise opens the deck warning for that card (sound 0x7a0c); system_get_confirm_button(0) (0x4000) on a card enters the card viewer (state 4, sub-state 0, sound 0x7a05); triangle (0x1000) opens the menu (the sound id is shown by the decompiler as a BOOT address, unrecovered); L (0x100) and R or square (0x8200) switch tab (previous/next, modulo 3, sound 0x7a0d); SELECT (0x1) toggles the grid view flag bit 2 of byte 0xa6c5 (sound 0x7a05) and re-places the cursor with ui_limitlist_place_cursor (layout 0x60b grid, 0x701 rows); otherwise moves the cursor (grid or list mover). After a tab switch it also re-places the cursor. Always updates the cursor rectangle, the detail card and scrolls the detail text with the analog stick (shop_scroll_with_analog on 0xa6f4). No return value. Side effects: screen state, cursor, tab bits, sounds, fade. Callers: 1 (deck_limit_list_update).

Card viewer state 4, sub-state 0xa6c2: 0 starts a fade-out; 1 when the fade is done opens the full card viewer for the selected entry (ui_card_viewer_open(id, resource 0x800c, resource 0x8012), ui_card_viewer_set_pack_source(resource 0x8015)), sets the viewer flag bit 3 of byte 0xa6c5 and goes to 2, or with no entry fades in and goes to 3; 2 waits for ui_card_viewer_update to return non-zero, clears the flag and fades in; 3 waits for the fade, then sub-state 0 and state 2. No return value. Side effects: sub-state, flags, fades, card viewer. Callers: 1 (deck_limit_list_update).

Sets the play range of the tab layout (EHF resource 0x1010) to frames tab..tab + 1 (ui_ehf_set_play_range) when the resource is loaded. No return value. Side effects: EHF player state. Callers: 2 (ui_limitlist_build_lists, ui_limitlist_update_browse).

Row-view cursor: with the pad repeat word +0xc moves the cursor 0xa6cc[t] down (0x40) or up (0x10) within 7 visible rows, scrolling the top 0xa6c6[t] when it leaves the window (clamped to count - 7); a newly pressed up on the first entry jumps to the last, a newly pressed down on the last entry jumps to the first. Plays sound 0x7a04 when top or cursor changed. No return value. Side effects: 0xa6c6/0xa6cc of the current tab, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_update_browse).

Grid-view cursor (11 columns, 6 visible rows): up/down (0x10/0x40 on the repeat word +0xc) move by rows and scroll the top 0xa6c6[t] in steps of 11, with wrap from the first row to the last and back on a new press; left/right (0x80/0x20) move the column modulo 11 within the row; stores cursor 0xa6cc[t] = column + 11 * row. Plays sound 0x7a04 when anything changed. No return value. Side effects: 0xa6c6/0xa6cc of the current tab, sound. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_update_browse).

Computes the cursor rectangle used by deck_limit_list_draw from the cursor c = 0xa6cc[t]: grid view x 0x9c + (c % 11) * 0x1c, y 0x2e + (c / 11) * 0x22, size 0x17 x 0x1f; row view x 0x98, y 0x2a + c * 0x1e, size 0x13b x 0x1d (halfwords 0xa6d2, 0xa6d4, 0xa6d6, 0xa6d8). No return value. Side effects: those four halfwords. Callers: 2 (ui_limitlist_build_lists, ui_limitlist_update_browse).

Looks up the entry under the cursor (top + cursor < count of the current tab); when it has a non-zero card id different from the one in the card detail view block (word 0xa6f4) stores it there, resets the text scroll word 0xa6fc and returns 1. Returns 0 when there is no entry or nothing changed. Side effects: 0xa6f4, 0xa6fc. Callers: 2 (ui_limitlist_build_lists, ui_limitlist_update_browse).

qsort comparator for card ids: orders by card_db_get_frame (smaller first), then by card_db_get_sort_position difference. Returns negative, zero or positive. No side effects. No direct caller (passed to system_qsort by ui_limitlist_build_lists).

Checks the player's deck against the current list: counts the copies of every card of member 0's three lists (list numbers from the u16 table 0xa0f4, main/side/extra) into a local {u16 id, u16 count} table with ui_limitlist_count_card, then for each distinct card with limit < 3 (deck_get_current_card_limit): returns its id when limit 1 or 2 is exceeded, or when it is forbidden (limit 0) and more forbidden cards were seen than allowed (one is tolerated when save_test_progress_flag_e9_bit0 is set, as in deck_check_deck_valid). Returns 0 when the deck is legal. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_update_browse).

column2: int ui_limitlist_count_card(void *table, short card_id, int count)
column3: Linear search of the first count {u16 id, u16 copies} records of table for card_id: increments its copies and returns count, or appends {card_id, 1} and returns count + 1. Side effects: writes table. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_find_deck_violation).

column2: void ui_limitlist_place_cursor(int index, uint layout, uint count, ushort *top, short *column, short *row)
column3: Converts an absolute list index into a scroll top and cursor position for a layout word of columns (low byte) and visible rows (high byte): with count < 2 all three outputs become 0; otherwise first clamps *top so the window does not run past the end (adjusting *row by the change), then clamps index to count - 1 and, when it is not negative, sets *top = 0 when its row is within the first page or columns * (row - (rows - 1)) otherwise, *column = index % columns and *row = index / columns - *top / columns. No return value. Side effects: the three outputs. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_update_browse, with layouts 0x60b and 0x701).
Same code as BOOT deck_compare_u16_ascending: returns *a - *b. No side effects. No direct caller (passed to system_qsort by ui_limitlist_init_resources).

column2: int ui_deck_find_resource(ushort id, void *table, int count)
column3: Same code as rel_deck ui_deck_find_resource: binary search of count 12-byte resource records (u16 id at +0, ascending) for id. Returns the index or -1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_get_resource).

Resets the loader byte 0xac50 to "idle, step 0" (bit 0 set) and sorts the two resource tables by id with system_qsort and deck_compare_u16_ascending: 0xa3dc (0x29 records of 12 bytes, ids with bit 0x8000) and 0xa5f4 (3 records, ids with bit 0x1000). No return value. Side effects: 0xac50, table order. Callers: 1 (deck_limit_list_start).

Loading steps, step in bits 1-7 of 0xac50, run only while bit 0 (idle) is set: 0 loads the first archive (ui_limitlist_load_archive; its argument is not shown by the decompiler), 1 loads archive 2; each advances when the load completes (shop_on_archive_loaded) or the archive is already present; 2 allocates 0x135000 bytes at 0xac54 and opens the card image reader card_db_open_cardh_cip(buf, 0x135000, 0) into 0xa6f0; 3 when card_db_cip_is_ready opens the card view (ui_card_view_open) with the 0x24-byte parameters {resources 0x8007, 0x8009, 0x8024, 0x8011, a fifth resource whose id the decompiler shows as a BOOT address, ..., reader 0xa6f0 at +0x1c}, sets the detail card 0xa6f4 = -1 and 0xa6fc = 0; any later step resets the step and returns 1. Returns 0 while loading. Side effects: loader byte, heap allocation, card reader, card view. Callers: 1 (deck_limit_list_update).

Frees the card image buffer 0xac54 and the data of both archive records of the table 0xa124 (word +4 of each 12-byte record) from the work heap, clearing the pointers. No return value. Side effects: heap frees. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_shutdown_step).

Finds archive_id in the 2-record archive table 0xa124 (12 bytes: u16 id +0, data pointer +4, path format +8); returns the data pointer when it is set. Otherwise, when the loader is idle (bit 0 of 0xac50), formats the path with the language letter of the string 0xa090 ("jegfis" indexed by save_get_language), clears the idle bit, gets the file size under root 3 (USRDIR), allocates it from the work heap, stores the pointer and starts container_load_file with callback shop_on_archive_loaded. Returns 0 when the load was just started or the id is unknown. Side effects: heap allocation, file load, 0xac50. Callers: 2 (ui_limitlist_get_resource, ui_limitlist_update_loading).

Returns a member of the screen's archives by resource id: ids with bit 0x8000 are looked up in the table 0xa3dc (0x29 records), ids with bit 0x1000 in 0xa5f4 (3 records); record = {u16 id, u16 archive id, cached member pointer +4, member-name format +8}. When the cache is empty it gets the archive (ui_limitlist_load_archive), formats the member name with the language letter (or, for ids 0x8036 and 0x8037, with the third character of the 8-byte string 0xa618), finds it with container_ehp_find_member and caches it. Returns the member pointer, or 0 when unknown or not loaded. Side effects: the cache word. Callers: 14 (ui_limitlist_draw_menu_item, ui_limitlist_update_card_viewer, ui_limitlist_build_lists, ui_limitlist_draw_background, ...).

Same code as rel_shop shop_on_archive_loaded: when size > 0 binds the EHP (container_ehp_bind_with_callback(NULL, ehp) if ehp is set) and increments the step counter in bits 1-7 of 0xac50; always sets bit 0 (idle). Returns size > 0. Side effects: 0xac50, EHP binding. No direct caller (container_load_file callback set by ui_limitlist_load_archive).

Same code as rel_shop shop_find_in_sorted_table: binary search of value in the ascending u16 list table[1..table[0]]; returns its index, or 0 when table is NULL or the value is absent. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_limitlist_build_lists, with table resource 0x8031 to get the thumbnail index).

column2: int shop_find_card_art_variant(uint card_id, int variant, int *table)
column3: Same code as rel_shop shop_find_card_art_variant: linear search of table (table[0] = count, then words) for (card_id & 0xffff) | variant << 16; returns the index or -1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (shop_get_card_thumb_cell).
Same code as rel_shop shop_get_frame_style_index: 0->0, 1->1, 2->2, 3->3, 7->5, 8->6, 10->4, else -1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_card_frame_plate).

column2: void * shop_draw_number_plain(void *list, uint x, short y, int value, int step, uint digits, int pad)
column3: Same code as rel_shop shop_draw_number_plain: draws value digit by digit from right to left, each digit step pixels further left, at most digits places, stopping after the most significant non-zero digit unless pad; wrapped in an external font list whose end is the returned list (confidence medium). Side effects: font drawing. Callers: 2 (shop_draw_results_row_badges, ui_limitlist_draw_tabs).

column2: void ui_limitlist_draw_digit_text(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Same code as BOOT ui_list_window_draw_text: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (shop_draw_number_plain, shop_draw_stat_value).

column2: void * shop_draw_attribute_icon(void *list, uint xy, short attribute, void *image)
